last_improvement.poison_result: MAJOR BRANCH-COVERAGE poison. Rule: each zero hole reads its first non-zero neighbour color C, compares row-extent (C-or-0 cells in its row) vs col-extent (in its column); row>=col -> CLEAR COLUMN, else CLEAR ROW. The branch depends on BAND ORIENTATION: horizontal bands (full-width, short) -> row-ext(w)>=col-ext(bh) -> clear-column; vertical bands (full-height, narrow) -> col-ext(h)>row-ext(bw) -> clear-row. Canonical MIXES both (pair0/pair3 horizontal -> clear-column; pair1/pair2 VERTICAL -> clear-row). But v2.0.0 only ever built HORIZONTAL bands -> the clear-ROW branch was NEVER exercised in the main distribution (only via degenerates). Also the v2 INVARIANT 'rows are wider than column-extents (so erase column fires)' literally hard-coded the one-branch bias. Fix: added orientation axis; build a wide horizontal-band grid (w>=h, guarantees clear-column) and TRANSPOSE it for vertical (tall, full-height bands, guarantees clear-row). Holes now forced into band INTERIORS (strictly inside, inner cols) so the first neighbour is always the band's own color (matches canonical). Verified across 120 instances: clear-column fires 61x (horizontal), clear-row fires 59x (vertical) -- both branches now covered; all 120 outputs change.
last_improvement.robustness: 120 instances (both orientations x 3 difficulties): all change; both rule branches exercised ~evenly

(1) BG COULD BE 0: palette drawn exclude=set() -> bg=palette[0] could be 0 in 15/45 instances, but the rule uses 0 as the TRANSPARENT marker WITHIN a container (canonical bg is always nonzero: 8/1/9); bg=0 collapses the transparent scheme. Fixed: exclude={0} so bg+fills are all nonzero. (2) CONTAINERS NOT SOLID BOXES: old gen filled each box cell with a color at density and LEFT THE REST AS BG -> a container was bg+scattered-colors, so colored cells formed small/unequal 8-conn components, NOT one box-sized solid component; the rule grabs first component's bbox -> produced (1,1)/(3,1)/(4,2) tiny outputs (canonical containers are SOLID boxes of {0,color}, all non-bg, so the whole box is ONE component of bbox box_h x box_w, identical across containers). Fixed: every container cell is now 0 (transparent) or a fill color, never bg; >=1 colored cell guaranteed. (3) SEPARATION ONLY in structured layouts: scattered layout placed boxes at random with NO overlap check + structured layouts clamp-collided -> boxes could overlap/8-touch and MERGE into one component. Fixed: _fits() expand-by-1 bbox rejection enforced on EVERY layout + random-fill safety net guaranteeing >=2 separated boxes.
